gloss: to wear; to put on; to have on

definitions.gloss: to wear; to put on; to have on
definitions.explanation: A formal term for wearing clothes or equipment on one's body. Used in official instructions, signs, regulations, and formal announcements rather than everyday conversation.

examples.japanese: マスクを{着用|ちゃくよう}する。
ヘルメットの{着用|ちゃくよう}が{義務|ぎむ}づけられている。
{工場|こうじょう}{内|ない}では{安全靴|あんぜんぐつ}を{着用|ちゃくよう}してください。
examples.english: Please wear safety shoes inside the factory.

examples.japanese: シートベルトを{着用|ちゃくよう}しないと{罰金|ばっきん}が{科|か}されます。
examples.english: If you don't wear a seatbelt, you will be fined.

notes:
More formal than {着|き}る or かぶる. Primarily seen on signs, in regulations, and in official announcements. Became extremely common during the COVID-19 pandemic in the phrase マスク{着用|ちゃくよう} (mask wearing).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- マスク{着用|ちゃくよう}: mask wearing
- {着用|ちゃくよう}{義務|ぎむ}: obligation to wear
- ヘルメット{着用|ちゃくよう}: helmet wearing
- {着用|ちゃくよう}{率|りつ}: wearing rate
- {常時|じょうじ}{着用|ちゃくよう}: wearing at all times

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {着|き}る: to wear (clothes) — everyday term for wearing clothing on the torso
- かぶる: to wear (on head) — everyday term for hats, helmets
- {身|み}に{着|つ}ける: to wear, carry on one's person — includes accessories and items
